remarks:
Perched along the Chautauqua Gorge, this custom-built home offers dramatic views, the sound of the creek below, and a private setting just minutes from the heart of the Village of Westfield. Built in 2023, the home combines modern construction with a layout designed to take full advantage of its surroundings.

An inviting foyer with built-in shelving and soaring ceilings welcomes you into the home. The first floor includes the primary suite, currently used as a Pilates studio, with vaulted ceilings, a private bath, walk-in closet, and direct access to the covered patio and fenced backyard. The space could also work well as a family room, guest suite, home gym, or private workspace.

Upstairs, expansive windows fill the open main living area with natural light while framing the gorge views. The kitchen is the showstopper, featuring a large center island, quartz countertops, abundant cabinetry, and incredible views. The adjoining great room opens to a covered deck, extending the living space outdoors and providing a front-row seat to the scenery and sounds of the gorge below.

Also on this level are two bedrooms, a full bath, and a convenient laundry closet. One bedroom is currently used as an additional sitting room.

Outside, thoughtful landscaping and a fenced backyard create a private outdoor space surrounded by the natural beauty of the gorge. An attached two-car garage, low-maintenance exterior, quality finishes, and a Google Nest thermostat with multiple sensors add everyday convenience.

Whether used as a full-time residence, second home, or potential vacation rental, this nearly new property combines modern construction, versatile living space, and a location that would be difficult to recreate—all within minutes of Westfield’s shops, restaurants, parks, and village amenities.
